camel_example: aliyun devops GET /organization/5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx/listProjects --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken 'example-string' --maxResults 20 --extraConditions '附加过滤条件' --scope all --conditions '{"conditionGroups":[[]]}' --category Project --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Retrieve a list of projects, supporting conditional search
description_zh: 获取项目列表，支持条件搜索
name: ListProjects

parameters.help_en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id
extra_conditions

parameters.help_en: Leave this field empty for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the value of this field from the previous response to retrieve the next set of paginated data
parameters.help_zh: 第一页值不需要填写，后面每一页的值需要从前一次调用结果中获取到此字段，然后获取后面的分页数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of results returned per page, ranging from 0 to 200. Default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大返回数量，0-200，默认值20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Visibility Type, with values "all" or "collect", representing all projects or my collected projects, respectively
parameters.help_zh: 公开类型，all/collect，分别代表所有的项目或者我收藏的
parameters.name: scope
